scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:setup:local: bun run db:migrate:local && bun run db:seed:local
scripts.db:setup:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to="${E2E_PERSIST_PATH:-.wrangler/e2e-state-v2}" && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to="${E2E_PERSIST_PATH:-.wrangler/e2e-state-v2}" --file=./seed/local.sql
scripts.r2:lifecycle:setup: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add "${R2_BUCKET_NAME:-openworkspace}" openworkspace-composer-uploads composer-uploads/ --expire-days 7 --force && wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add "${R2_BUCKET_NAME:-openworkspace}" openworkspace-drive-staging drive/staging/ --expire-days 7 --force
scripts.typecheck: bun run cf-typegen && tsc -b && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json

DB.description: D1 stores domains, users, passkeys, sessions, mailbox ownership and permissions, global settings, and one-time access links.

MAILBOX.description: One SQLite-backed Durable Object per mailbox stores RFC metadata and conversation state.

MAIL_STORAGE.description: R2 stores raw MIME, HTML bodies, and attachments outside the relational hot path.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional. R2 S3 API access key for presigned attachment uploads and MCP downloads. Create under R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional. R2 S3 API secret for presigned attachment uploads and MCP downloads.

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional. Cloudflare account id used in `https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.

R2_BUCKET_NAME.description: Optional. R2 bucket name for presigned attachment transfers (defaults to openworkspace).

IMAGES.description: Cloudflare Images stores profile avatars. Delivery URLs use imagedelivery.net with a public variant.

AI.description: Workers AI optionally checks incoming messages for spam and routes them to mailbox folders before notifications are sent.

EMAIL.description: Email Service sends outbound mail. Onboard the sending domain after deployment.

CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN.description: Optional secret. Cloudflare API token with Analytics Read for every configured mail zone.

PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Queue for Web Push delivery after incoming mail is committed.

WEBHOOKS.description: Queue for signed account-wide webhook fan-out, retries, and delivery isolation.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional. Public half of the persistent Web Push VAPID key pair.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional secret. Private half of the persistent Web Push VAPID key pair.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Optional VAPID contact URI, for example mailto:admin@example.com.

IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ORIGIN.description: Optional. Canonical public HTTPS origin shared by the OIDC and SAML identity providers, e.g. `https://mail.example.com`. Set with `wrangler secret put IDENTITY_PROVIDER_ORIGIN` after deploy — do not use localhost.

OIDC_SIGNING_PRIVATE_JWK.description: Optional. RSA private JWK for the OIDC IdP. Generate with `bun run oidc:keygen`, then `wrangler secret put OIDC_SIGNING_PRIVATE_JWK`.

SAML_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional secret. PEM private key used to sign SAML responses and assertions. Generate with `bun run saml:keygen`.

SAML_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE.description: Optional. PEM X.509 certificate published in SAML IdP metadata. Generate with `bun run saml:keygen`.

SAML_ADDITIONAL_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES.description: Optional. PEM bundle of additional RSA certificates published during SAML signing-key rotation.
